'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2023 Mogadishu hotel attack]]
***Six civilians and three soldiers are killed and ten others are injured by [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] at a hotel in [[Lido Beach, Mogadishu|Lido Beach]], [[Mogadishu]]. All seven attackers are also killed. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/06/10/Six-civilians-killed-10-wounded-in-Somalia-hotel-siege-Police (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 bombing of Odesa]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] attack [[Odesa]] with [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] and missiles, killing three [[civilian]]s and injuring 27 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-killed-russian-drone-attack-odesa-overnight-ukraine-2023-06-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 25 people are killed and 145 others are injured after heavy rains cause houses to collapse across [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-storm-deaths-645f09129ef7747987c14ccd97d1c684 (AP)]
*Five people are killed in an [[explosion]] at a missile and [[explosive]]s factory in [[Ankara]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/10/deadly-blast-rocks-explosives-factory-in-turkeys-capital (Al Jazeera)]
*Two people are killed after a small plane crashes in the [[Superstition Mountains]] in [[Arizona]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/plane-crash-arizona-superstition-mountains-097128632c57904213d201aa33d498b5 (AP)]
*Fourteen people are killed in [[wildfire]]s in north-eastern [[Kazakhstan]], while 316 others are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]], according to the [[Ministry of Emergency Situations (Kazakhstan)|Emergency Situations Ministry]]. Kazakh President [[Kassym-Jomart Tokayev]] responds by sacking Emergency Situations Minister [[Yuri Ilyin]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/10/fourteen-people-killed-in-kazakhstan-forest-fires (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Chile]] reports an outbreak of [[respiratory syncytial virus]], which has killed four people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/respiratory-disease-outbreak-chile-strains-pediatric-icu-capacity-2023-06-09/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–Ukraine relations]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***Canadian Prime Minister [[Justin Trudeau]] announces a $500 million military aid package to Ukraine (including 288 [[AIM-7]] missiles) and a $10 million humanitarian aid package to help victims of the [[destruction of the Kakhovka Dam|Kakhovka dam collapse]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/06/10/ukraines-fight-for-the-future-of-us-all-trudeau-says-on-surprise-trip-to-kyiv.html (CNBC)]
*[[Foreign relations of Romania]]
**[[Romania]] recalls its ambassador to [[Kenya]] after he used a [[racist slur]] during a meeting with [[African Group]] representatives in [[Nairobi]] in April. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/11/romania-recalls-kenya-envoy-for-calling-africans-monkeys (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Two people are killed and two more injured during a [[mass shooting]] outside the entrance of a [[Metro station|subway station]] in [[Farsta]], [[Stockholm]], [[Sweden]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sweden-shooting-gang-violence-993e8ed47e55c16befb847e9685c7b33 (AP)]
*[[Ted Kaczynski]] (also known as the Unabomber) died by [[suicide]] at the Federal Medical Center in [[Butner, North Carolina]]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 French Open]]
**In [[tennis]], defending champion [[Iga Świątek]] defeats [[Karolína Muchová]] 6–2, 5–7, 6–4 in the final to win the [[2023 French Open – Women's singles|women's singles]] title at the 2023 [[French Open]]. Świątek is the first player to defend the title since [[Justine Henin]] in [[2007 French Open – Women's singles|2007]] and the first woman to defend a [[Grand Slam (tennis)#Tournaments|major]] title since [[Serena Williams]] at [[2016 Wimbledon Championships – Women's singles|Wimbledon in 2016]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/06/10/tennis/iga-swiatek-karolina-muchova-french-open-final-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2022–23 UEFA Champions League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Manchester City F.C|Manchester City]] win their first [[UEFA Champions League]] title with a 1–0 victory over [[Inter Milan]] in the [[2023 UEFA Champions League final|final]] at the [[Atatürk Olympic Stadium]] in [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]], with [[Rodri (footballer, born 1996)|Rodri]] scoring the winner. Having also won the [[2022–23 Premier League|Premier League]] and [[2022–23 FA Cup|FA Cup]] that season, City become the second English club to complete the [[Treble (association football)|continental treble]] after [[Manchester derby|rivals]] [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] in [[1998–99 Manchester United F.C. season|1999]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/05/29/football/chelsea-manchester-city-champions-league-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2023/jun/10/rodri-breaks-internazionale-resistance-to-seal-manchester-citys-treble-glory (''The Guardian'')]
